Reduces Firing Delay for #e${2.5+#d} seconds upon readying the weapon after scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 4 seconds of each with a different weapon.

Timer starts upon readying. Buff can be stowed for 5 seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 40% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 30% on other archetypes.

Activation progress on Precision Hits:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns: 50%
• Hand Cannons, Sidearms, Scout Rifles 17 5%
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns: 8%

enhanced (
var d = 0.25
#e Buff duration is increased by 0.25 seconds.
)

After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Grants the 'Cascade Point Ready' buff for 5 seconds.

Readying the weapon while Cascade Point Ready is active reduces Firing Delay for #e${2.5+#d} seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.

Activation progress on Precision Hits:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns: 50%
• Hand Cannons, Sidearms, Scout Rifles: 17.5%
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns: 8%

var d = 0.25

After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:

Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for #e${2.5+#d} seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.

Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits
